subject: RM_Toothmoss
departures: the carpet is made of many small individual teeth, not leaves, fronds or stems
the tooth surfaces are hard, enamel-like and bone-coloured instead of soft green plant tissue
the teeth have worn, flattened grinding crowns like molars, not pointed shoots or spore stalks
the teeth grow straight out of bare, scorched, sterile ground at a burn edge, with no humus or other plants around them
it forms a low, flat, close-set mat of crowns with no fuzzy or feathery texture
